description: This bar chart, titled "QLoRA," illustrates the GPU memory usage in gigabytes (GB) for various fine-tuning methods when applied to Llama-3-8B on ten NLP tasks. The vertical axis, labeled "GPU Memory (GB)," is scaled linearly from 0 to 60 GB with major gridlines at 20, 40, and 60, and minor gridlines at 10 GB intervals. The horizontal axis lists seven distinct fine-tuning approaches: "Full FT," "MTL-FT," "TAG," "LoRA," "QLoRA," and "Ours." All bars except the last are colored orange, while the bar for "Ours" is colored green. The bar for "Full FT" is the tallest, reaching approximately 70 GB. The "MTL-FT" bar is next, at about 40 GB. The "TAG," "LoRA," and "QLoRA" bars are all approximately 20 GB in height. The "Ours" bar is the shortest among the non-orange bars, at approximately 20 GB. The bars are arranged in descending order of memory usage from left to right. The chart does not indicate any visual emphasis or annotation on specific bars.
